Alex P: Heads up — nightly SAST/DAST run started failing at 03:12 UTC. CI shows: `scanner-service: decrypt failed` and the pipeline is blocked. https://ci.redwood/example/552
scan-bot: job #552 failed · reason: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED · retries=0
Maria G: Was there a key rotation scheduled around 03:00? @infra oncall?
TJ K: Yes — we rotated the master key at 03:05 for the keystore rotation window. I ran the rotation script but I think the grant for the `scanner-service-account` missed the `Decrypt` action in the staging account.
Samir R: Can you paste the grant output? If grant exists but wrong perms, that explains it. Temporary workaround is to point scanner to previous alias until grant corrected.
Irene L: Quick repro: run `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id alias/old-key` from the scanner host to confirm decrypt path. If that works, we know it's grant/perm related.
Alex P: Repro logs from the scanner agent —
```
2026-03-21T03:11:58Z scanner[pid:23]: request id=xyz decrypt -> KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED AccessDenied
2026-03-21T03:12:00Z scanner[pid:23]: failing stage: token fetch
```
Maria G: Triage proposal:
1) Add missing `Decrypt` grant to scanner SA ASAP (hotfix)
2) Restart nightly run
3) If passes, open follow-up to add unit/e2e check in rotation script to validate grants
4) Investigate missing audit events (see below)
@infra-bot tagging for visibility
TJ K: I applied an additional grant with `Decrypt` and restarted the job (rolled forward). Will report back in 60s.
Samir R: I can't find a CloudTrail event for `kms:CreateGrant` between 03:05-03:10 — the keystore audit pipeline seems to have a gap. Either the rotation script used a service principal that bypasses traceability or CloudTrail ingestion lagged.
Irene L: Which audit store did you check? We need checks in both CloudTrail and our keystore-agent logs (keystore-agent -> s3 audit bucket). If CloudTrail shows nothing, that is higher severity (audit gap).
Maria G: Agreed — escalate if audit logs don't show the rotation/grant. Create an incident if we cannot reconstruct actions in the audit trail. Tag: security-audit-gap.
Alex P: Jobs are green on rerun — nightly scan completed after the hotfix. But we still need the audit follow-up.
TJ K: I'll open a hotfix PR to add a sanity check to `rotation.sh`: after rotate -> call `aws kms list-grants --key-id $KEY` and assert `Decrypt` present for scanner SA, fail the rollout if not. Also adding `--wait` for audit event to appear to reduce blind rollouts.
Samir R: Add an alert: `scanner.decrypt.failures > 3 in 15m` => Pager oncall and create auto-incident INC-{{auto}}. Also file a runbook step to validate both CloudTrail + keystore-agent ingestion.
Irene L: Filing ticket for audit ingestion gap: TKT-2026. Linking logs and retention policy.
Maria G: Filed INC-2026 for the rotation-induced scan blocker; added owners: @TJ K (rotation fix), @Samir R (alerts/runbook), @Irene L (audit ingestion). PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/rotation/+/1234
Alex P: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 
- TJ: PR + deploy rotation check
- Samir: Pager rule + runbook entry
- Irene: Confirm audit pipeline health and backfill logs if missing
I'll close this thread once PR merged and incident created. :thumbsup:
